description:
Problem and evidence
lib/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge.ex delivery_attachments/3 still consumes {:ok, %{metadata: %{delivery_report: %{messages: messages}}}} and recursively constructs aggregate receipts, failures and uploaded_files. Current grouping and aggregate reporting belong to Delivery.Executor; each adapter publication should represent one message. Inspection found no producer of this report shape in installed Mattermost, Discord or Telegram sources; Mattermost resets delivery_report to nil. Introduction/retirement history has not yet been traced, so verify reachability before deletion.

Implementation
Trace this clause's history and all supported adapter/SDK producers, selected pins, custom adapter contracts and test doubles. If no supported producer remains, remove only the obsolete aggregate adapter-report clause and code proven exclusive to it. Keep adjacent single-message media/source-author normalization and Record attachment metadata conversion. Keep Executor reporting and Confirmation history bookkeeping. report_file_failures and sanitization helpers have other callers (including error normalization); do not delete them without independently proving them unused. If a live supported producer exists, record its concrete contract and stop short of removing that compatibility; do not guess or expand provider scope.

Action reuse: use Executor as the sole aggregate-report owner while retaining bridge normalization for individual provider receipts. No new adapter wrapper or parallel report abstraction.

Tests
Inspect jido_chat_delivery_test.exs, jido_chat_bridge_test.exs, delivery/executor_test.exs and delivery/confirmation_test.exs. Remove fake legacy multi-message adapter-report fixtures and tests only after producer verification. Preserve/migrate multi-group, partial/unknown outcomes, original-index accounting and history assertions to executor-owned reports. Retain provider media metadata and failure sanitization tests with live callers. Coordinate edits with the Jido text cleanup.

Authorization and boundaries
User explicitly requested these four cleanup issues on 2026-11-20 and approved removing tests related to this cleanup. Remove tests/fixtures that exist solely for retired APIs, unreachable branches, or unsupported legacy report shapes. Migrate assertions for still-supported behavior to the retained production boundary; do not remove security, byte-integrity, history, callback, or delivery-policy coverage merely because its old entry point disappears. Record the exact deleted tests and retained/migrated coverage in completion notes. This approval does not authorize unrelated behavior changes, dependency publication, commit/push, or final UX/E2E acceptance.

Implementation guidance
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/services/channels.md, and applicable naming/code-quality guidance. Read docs/documentation.md before updating stale API documentation. Recheck live callers and workspace changes before editing; review evidence was collected at f6a1d3070. No new Action or tool exposure is needed: this is local cleanup of existing Channel operations.

Validation and completion
Run focused affected existing suites and mix q per docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md. Preserve meaningful existing properties; introduce no tests that merely mirror private helpers. Report failures honestly, including unrelated known failures. Final coverage and mix precommit remain under zaq-1lw.13. This issue blocks architecture review zaq-1lw.12; sibling cleanups have no semantic dependency. Coordinate edits with other workers.
